text:
maria: Quick sync 1: we found a decode regression on runtime 3.3 when used with SDK 2.8.0 for quant-v3b on long sequences. Failure mode: occasional token duplication+skip leading to malformed outputs. Can we soft-pin runtime back to 3.2.1 in eu-west while we ship a microfix? Requesting region-scoped pin and an automatic fallback to v3a if errors spike.
lee: Can you share the failure rate & user impact?
maria: Observed ~0.3%-0.6% degraded responses on canary traffic (longseq > 2048). Affects internal evals and a small set of customers running long context. No CPU spikes, looks decode-only.
jon: Region pin sounds right. Recommend a 4h TTL and a QA gate before any global changes. Also add metric-based auto-reroute.
sana: +1 eu-west only. I'll prep the smoke eval and user-impact diff.

maria: Proposed deploybot command (region pin + reason + TTL):

```bash
/deploybot pin add --model quant-v3b --runtime 3.2.1
  --regions eu-west
  --ttl 4h
  --reason "decode regression with runtime 3.3 + SDK2.8 on longseq"
```

deploybot: starting pin workflow -> applying to 42 canaries/nodes in eu-west.

deploybot: PIN APPLIED model=quant-v3b runtime=3.2.1 regions=[eu-west] nodes=42 ttl=4h id=pin-7892

lee: Can we add a fallback policy now? If decode_errors > 30/min for 10m, route model quant-v3b -> quant-v3a (degraded quality).
jon: I'll create the reroute policy and link it here (policy reroute-78). Will also wire alert: alert if decode_errors rate increases.
sana: Smoke eval started. Running regen + token-diff; will post summary in 12m.
ops-bot: FYI posting short note to #ops: "Temporary regional runtime pin applied for quant-v3b in eu-west. Pin id: pin-7892. Fallback policy reroute-78 will be attached."

maria: Plan recap:
- Applied regional pin: runtime 3.2.1 for quant-v3b in eu-west (pin-7892).
- TTL: 4 hours, QA smoke gate during first 60m.
- Auto-fallback: reroute-78 to quant-v3a on decode_errors threshold.
- Follow-up: runtime 3.3.1 patch expected in ~12-18h; staged unpin after patch + verification.

lee: +1. If smoke looks good, propose keeping pin for 6h then re-evaluate.
jon: reroute policy created: reroute-78. Attached alert id: alert-331. Will enable immediate activation.
sana: Smoke eval results: diffs minimal on pinned runtime, canary still shows the bug. No customer-facing alerts in first 20m. Posting diff artifacts: link internal: //artifacts/smoke/1795560000/diffs.
maria: thanks. keeping watch. I'll update release-notes draft and add a brief note for support.
ops-bot: release-notes entry draft: "Temporary regional runtime pin: quant-v3b -> runtime 3.2.1 in eu-west due to decode mismatch on runtime 3.3. Fallback to quant-v3a on increased error rate. Pin id pin-7892."

deploybot: to remove pin later: /deploybot pin remove --id pin-7892 --reason "post-patch unpin"

maria: Excellent work team. If alert-331 fires I'll call for a brief incident huddle. Otherwise we'll target staged unpin after runtime 3.3.1 roll and ✅ QA.
